        task = tasks.setdefault(data["task_id"], {"episodes": [], "policy_ids": set()})

## Review Summary

This PR adds test and documentation only for Story 20.6 (the warm-start real-data check). No production code is changed.

**One blocking defect found:**

In `tests/test_warm_start_real_data.py`, `_recorded_tasks()` accesses `data["policy_id"]` (line 77) without a guard. If any committed episode file that matches the agent/task criteria lacks a `"policy_id"` field, this raises an unhandled `KeyError` and the entire test module fails at collection or setup time, silently defeating all 7 contract tests. The parallel Story 19.7 real-data test (`test_meta_prior_real_data.py`) had this exact pattern flagged by Q-98-1 and fixed. A one-line guard (`if "policy_id" in data:`) eliminates the crash; the `policy_ids` set is only used for metadata recording and its incompleteness does not affect any test assertion.

All other aspects of the change (logic, security, documentation, AC coverage) are sound.
